correctness.rationale: Under fully specified continuous F0 and n≥2, applying the exact iid centered-Hilbert quadratic-form covariance formula to W_n²=⟨S,I S⟩ and U_n²=⟨S,P S⟩ yields Cov=(n−1)/(180n), Var W=(4n−3)/(180n), Var U=(n−1)/(360n), Corr=sqrt(2(n−1)/(4n−3)). Independently integrated Brownian-bridge kernel C(s,t)=min(s,t)−st to obtain tr Σ²=1/90, ||Σe||²=1/120, ⟨e,Σe⟩=1/12; so tr ΣPΣ=1/360 and tr ΣPΣP=1/720. For each one-observation bridge Z_y, ||Z_y||²=(y−1/2)²+1/12 and ⟨Z_y,PZ_y⟩=1/12 constant; one-sample joint covariance zero. Pairings give all n exactly; n=2 and the n→∞ correlation limit follow. This proof, not finite experiment or prior checker log, controls every n.
